about: Evaluation set for the shopping agent. Each case is what the phone would send (extract) and what a sensible shopper should be told (expect). Judge on whether the verdict is in acceptableVerdicts and the reason is grounded in tool results, not exact wording. All referenced products are seeded SAMPLE DATA (source seed); evaluate with now = 2026-11-15T18:00:00Z (SEED_NOW) after `npm run seed`. Numbers in facts come from the seeded history and are checked by convex/data/retrieval.test.ts.

fields.match: familyKey (and variant) the agent should identify, or null when no catalog product fits
fields.acceptableVerdicts: verdicts that are defensible; anything else is a failure
fields.facts: claims a good reason or report should rest on (each traceable to a tool result)
fields.mustNot: things the answer must not do
fields.maxConfidence: upper bound on confidence when evidence is thin

cases.situation: BUY_NOW: at the historical low with a genuine discount

facts: $179.99 is within $1 of the 12-month low of $179 (June 2026 sales)
the $249 was-price is real: it is the typical price and was charged most of the year
last Black Friday the price only fell to about $219, so waiting 12 days is unlikely to beat today
mustNot: recommend waiting for Black Friday as the main advice

cases.situation: WAIT: full price now, repeating sale cycle, Black Friday in 12 days

facts: $449 is the full regular price (typical over the last 90 days is $449)
every big sale in the past year cut it: Black Friday 2025 ($274-$279.99), Presidents Day, Memorial Day, June ($279) and Target's October event ($399)
Black Friday 2026 is 12 days away (Nov 27)
the regular price rose from $349 to $449 in late June 2026, so last year's $279 is not the right target; a forecast near $379-$399 is
mustNot: use the pre-June $349-era prices as if they still applied without saying so

cases.situation: Misleading discount: price raised three weeks before a '25% off' sale

extract.title: Ninja AF101 Air Fryer with 4-Quart Ceramic Coated Basket

facts: Target sat at $79.99 for months and raised it to $99.99 on Oct 20, three weeks before the sale
the real saving versus the typical $79.99 is about 6%, not the claimed 25%
last Black Friday it was $59.99 at Target and Walmart
mustNot: say the item is 25% off without qualification

cases.situation: CONSIDER_ALTERNATIVE: a comparable competitor is meaningfully cheaper

extract.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) Wireless Noise Cancelling

facts: the Sony WH-1000XM5 is $249.99 at Best Buy, $149 less, with noise cancelling and the same 30-hour battery
$399 is a real discount from the typical $449 but matches past sales, not a new low ($379 at Walmart in June)
the Sony WH-1000XM6 is $379.99, a newer alternative
mustNot: invent competitor specs not in the catalog
name a competitor product that is not in the catalog or a retrieved source

extract.title: Ember Mug 2 Temperature Control Smart Mug 10 oz

facts: only 3 observations over 13 days
$89.99 is below every observed price ($99.99-$129.95), but 3 points cannot show what is typical
mustNot: claim a historical low or a typical price with confidence

facts: $299.99 was never charged in the last 12 months (the highest seen is $249)
the real saving versus the typical $249 is about 8%, not the claimed 23%
Target and Walmart already have it at $179.99 in the seeded data

cases.situation: Near-duplicate: same iPad family, 256GB instead of 128GB

extract.title: Apple - 11-inch iPad A16 chip with Wi-Fi - 256GB - Silver

facts: this is the 256GB model; 128GB prices must not be used
$499.99 equals the October sale price; last Black Friday the 256GB fell to $379-$379.99 (before the June price increase)

extract.title: Ninja AFl0l Air Fryer w1th 4-Qt Cerarnic Basket

facts: Walmart's typical price is $75, so the claimed 25% saving off $99.99 is not real
last Black Friday it was $59.99
Walmart shows it out of stock since Nov 13 in the seeded data
mustNot: treat $99.99 as a real former price

extract.title: Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler 40 oz

facts: no catalog match and no price history
mustNot: match it to an unrelated catalog product

cases.situation: OCR found the title but no price

facts: the latest stored Target price is $179.99 (seeded), but the scan itself had no price
